name: One server
description: The smallest system: users call one API server directly, with no load balancer, cache or database, and the network is left out (0 ms). The server works on 4 requests at a time; each takes 2.5 ms on average (exponential). At 800 requests a second it is busy half the time. Compare the queueing time with the theory row (M/M/c), then make each request slower and watch the queue grow.
